title: Define and enforce the local snapshot manifest and compatibility gate

test_results.output_excerpt: test result: ok. 28 passed (unit: error/manifest/gate) | ok. 19 passed (manifest_compat integration) — 47 total, 0 failed

acceptance_criteria.required_fields_cannot_be_omitted: required_fields_cannot_be_omitted + builder_rejects_missing_fields: every top-level field is required; stripping any one fails deserialization, and the builder fails closed naming the missing field
acceptance_criteria.hash_mismatch_fails_before_load: flipping_one_byte_in_{memory,state,block_device}_is_typed_integrity_error: SnapshotError::Integrity -> ErrorCode::DigestMismatch, pure check before any child process
acceptance_criteria.memory_required_immutable: non_immutable_memory_fails_before_load: MemoryNotImmutable -> ErrorCode::SnapshotIncompatible; retention-while-running documented as a lifecycle contract
acceptance_criteria.crc_not_authentication_no_cross_host: lib.rs/manifest.rs/gate.rs trust-model docs: SHA-256 is orchestrator-owned; Firecracker CRC never treated as authentication; host envelope is a same-host record with no cross-host claim
acceptance_criteria.schema_type_example_drift_guard: rust_manifest_matches_json_schema_contract + schema_example_fixture_is_a_valid_manifest: Rust keys == schema required == schema properties; fixture deserializes into a valid manifest

qa_scenario.failure: flip one byte in memory/state/block device -> typed SnapshotError::Integrity (SnapshotIntegrityError) with ErrorCode::DigestMismatch before a child process is spawned
